d:
Vedānām Sāmavedosmi.
"Of the Vedas, I am the Samaveda." Krishna declared in the Gita. Notice he didn't say he was the Rigveda with its thousand hymns of conquest. Not the Yajurveda with its ritual precision. Not the Atharvaveda with its spells and counterspells. Just the Samaveda. The one most people skip.
